title: Pelican
blurb: Pelicans are a genus of large water birds that make up the family Pelecanidae. They are characterized by a long beak and a large throat pouch used for catching prey and draining water from the scooped-up contents before swallowing.
facts: They have predominantly pale plumage, except for the brown and Peruvian pelicans.
The bills, pouches, and bare facial skin of all pelicans become brightly coloured before the breeding season.
